title: PDPU 16-lane posit dot product, pipelined
description: The pipelined 16-lane posit dot-product-accumulate unit of PDPU (ISCAS 2023, Apache-2.0): sixteen posit(8,2) products summed into a posit(16,2) accumulator through radix-4 Booth multipliers, alignment with 14-bit truncation, a compressor tree and a final normalise-and-round, in five pipeline stages. The upstream SystemVerilog with N raised from 4 to 16 is the starting point; the 5-cycle latency is part of the contract.
flow: Yosys synthesis and OpenROAD static timing analysis on ASAP7. The gate-level netlist is re-simulated against the testbench on every evaluation: 2,000,000 vectors (directed corners and LFSR-driven broad vectors) streamed one per cycle and checked five edges later against the upstream combinational unit, which the testbench embeds as the reference model; the unit is architecturally inexact against ideal posit arithmetic, so bit-exactness to the reference is what counts.
footnotes: Rows labelled as measured before the current suite are earlier data (pre-v1 seed runs from July 2026 with an unpackaged rtlscout, or suite-v1 runs from October 2026 without the provider pin and completion cap). Each is replaced when reruns of that entry under the current suite are published.
All entries were called through OpenRouter without prompt caching, so every step pays for its full input.

Before 2026-10-12 the task text cited the starting point as `context/starting_point.v`; the file is `starting_point.v` in the agent's workspace, so every run of that period lost one step to a failed read. Corrected on 2026-10-12; the task is otherwise unchanged.
